card.name: Modifier before a plural noun
card.fires_on: A determiner, number or adjective right before a plural category noun, such as 'Specific' in 'Use in Specific Populations', 'Four' in 'Four Great Masters', or 'following' before 'conditions'.

modes.label: Specific Populations

modes.label: Number or 'following' before a list noun
modes.description: A count word or 'following' that introduces a set of items.
modes.example: Because most HPV infections are spread through sexual contact, men should also consider the following<< four>> ways to lower their HPV risk.

modes.label: Number in a title
modes.description: A number or quantity word in a title or phrase naming a group.
modes.example: He is regarded as one of the<< Four>> Great Masters of the Ming Dynasty.

card.plain: It fires on a small word like 'Specific' or 'Four' that comes just before a group noun such as 'Populations' or 'Masters'.
